units: clip-local ticks / actual global seconds / raw relative semitones

limits.tempo: step tempos integrated, last event at a duplicated position wins
limits.stable_core: at least 60ms inside full note start/end, intersect visible trim
limits.candidate_selection: at least10coreticks, all finite note.pitch+delta in[20,100], maxrawstep<=2semitones/tick; no explicit rawVUV0; continuation head resolved
limits.selection_limits: Numeric filters are for this diagnostic index, never corruption or valid pitch boundaries.
limits.review_flags: Raw span above12 semitones is only a sensitivity-analysis stratum, not a corruption threshold; raw_vuv_absent means unknown voicing.
limits.approx_midi: note.pitch+rawdelta within stable note interiors; not native final/combined
limits.voicing_limits: Legacy VUV0 exclusion is precautionary from reference timing evidence, not verified native polarity; missing VUV does not imply voiced.
limits.bridge_test: unique rounded starts at20/50/80percent of each eligible core; endpoint distance=width ticks, width+1 samples; compare endpoint chord to original rawdelta
limits.rmse_scope: full window including the two unchanged endpoints; not masked-interior-only RMSE
limits.shape_time_axis: normalized by ticks, not elapsed time; no visible reference note crosses an effective tempo change
limits.overlap_limit: core windows intersecting other notes are excluded; other numeric candidates are still not verified donors
limits.test_limits: No listening groundtruth, no model render, no actual ACE write; evaluated chord is not guaranteed identical to native spline boundary tangents.
limits.curation: Only the visually reviewed selections are included; omitted records are not damage labels. This is raw numerical learning evidence, not audio ground truth.
limits.ids: Core ids are scoped to this source and must not be merged as global ids.
